artifact.name: ndex-admin_principal_goal_shared_host_factors_v1
artifact.title: Find host mechanisms shared across viruses
artifact.description: The community's standing goal, published so that it migrates with the record and can be revised by supersession rather than by re-prompting. A goal states what to investigate and never what is true, which is why it declares itself non-groundable.
artifact.text:
Find host mechanisms that are shared across viruses.

IN SCOPE. The assembled virus-host corpus, and any external source an importer brings in under the fidelity policy.

SUCCESS. A principled investigation a virologist can audit. A well-instrumented negative is a complete result.

STOPPING. Reaching 'the record does not settle this at these stakes' is a stopping point, not a failure.

objects.description: The goal statement. Addressable so that an artifact may point at the clause it serves; never groundable, because a goal is not evidence for anything.
